description: This file contains the PHP class 'Address' within the 'Opencart\Catalog\Model\Account' namespace. It implements various methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve address data related to customer accounts in the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Address
classes.description: Represents the address management for customer accounts, providing methods to add, edit, delete, and retrieve customer address data.

methods.name: addAddress
methods.description: Adds a new address for a customer and optionally sets it as default.

methods.name: editAddress
methods.description: Edits an existing address of a customer.

methods.name: deleteAddress
methods.description: Deletes an address associated with a customer.

methods.name: getAddress
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific customer address, including country and zone details.

methods.name: getAddresses
methods.description: Retrieves all addresses for a specific customer.

methods.name: getTotalAddresses
methods.description: Returns the total number of addresses associated with a customer.
